title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・烈火轟轟

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on, come ooooon!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I won't let you win! Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaah! No way I'm gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now matter how high the mountain, I shall summit it! I will shine with the light of the aurora itself! Hyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Go! Go! Gooooo! You can do it, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: Come on, Oguriiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan B
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap is still just getting started! Right, Oguri?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's right. As long as I can hear your voices, I can still run! …RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No no no no! I am the strongest, and I… WILL… WIN!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: GET OUT OF MY WAAAAAY!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Look at Yaeno Muteki! Yaeno Muteki is surging ahead with incredible speed!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And Yaeno Muteki has won! She's kicked the competition to the curb and emerged victorious at the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Come on, Yaeno! How am I supposed to just watch while you run like that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I wanna run too! I wanna run with you as one of the top three!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, wheeze…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ugh, you gotta be kiddin' me! I knew you were holdin' back, but this is ridiculous!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That was totally the real you back there! "Get out of my way!"? Haha!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But I like it! I'll take that over you being all sensible any day!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I was on fire, but you were like the sun, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad we could finally face off for real! The true Yaeno has got the goods!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I agree. I felt like we were really able to get in sync today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I could feel the cry of your soul echoing inside me. Ahhh, I want to race you again as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone… Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You've worked so hard. I know it must've been difficult, even scary.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yet you pushed yourself to overcome it… Thank you. We all had an incredible race because of that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You were… incredible.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: There was no end to the power flowing out of you. I couldn't believe it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's incredible you can create all that by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I like racing you. Let's do it again.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'd also like to keep running with all of you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I can't believe that letting my emotions sweep me forward like that could feel so… invigorating!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan C
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Yaeno Muteki! You finally did it! I'm practically crying!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: So that's Yaeno Muteki… She's run against Ogurin a few times, but I had no idea she was this awesome!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: I guess I shouldn't be surprised, considering she's been able to hold her own against the Eternal Top Three!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan C
text_block_list.text: I've always considered Yaeno Muteki, Mejiro Ardan, and Sakura Chiyono O as the top three!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Hahah! That makes them all the Top Six, put together! What a generation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Cheers erupt throughout the racecourse. Everyone is shouting Yaeno Muteki's name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Visibly moved, she looks up at the stands and takes a deep bow.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Please allow me to introduce myself!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My name is Yaeno Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I would be honored if you would grace my future races with your presence!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: 170,000 spectators respond to her polite, almost martial tone with thunderous applause and cheers.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Caught up in the excitement, my words come out in a shout. Just thinking of the sight of Yaeno Muteki surrounded by her rivals, smiles abound, sets my heart leaping.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now that everyone has acknowledged my ability… I feel I gained some confidence in myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I've realized there are things about me worthy of praise.
choice_data_list: Of course there are! There are so many things about you I could praise.
Of course there are! There are so many things about you I could praise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her earnestness, her conscientiousness, her manners, her hardworking nature, her thoughtfulness, her kindness… I list them off in succession as they come to me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: W-w-wait a minute! There's no need to exaggerate!
choice_data_list: I'm not exaggerating. I can keep going.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Th-that's not necessary! I've heard enough!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Still… I'm so happy. My heart won't stop pounding.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Likely unused to this kind of praise, Yaeno Muteki looks at her feet, her cheeks turning red.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Today has been nothing short of joyous… I feel like I'm flying.
choice_data_list: Go ahead and bask in it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's certainly earned it with today's victory. Not only because she performed well, but also because we've found our path to victory.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hehe… If that's what you advise, I'll soak up this bliss until the moment I fall asleep tonight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A sincere smile lights her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may only have a few days to rest, but I hope it's a peaceful and healing period for her. After her long, painful journey, she certainly deserves it.
